verdict.rationale: Ramp MCP lets employees "get policy answers directly from their daily tools", and the AI Agents guide lists policy Q&A as a capability, which covers the conversational "can I expense this?" piece. Receipt chasing is documented in two ways: the MCP example prompt finds missing receipts and drafts reminders, and the CLI has missing, flag-missing and explain-missing commands. Ramp also sends automated reminders and supports submission via SMS, Slack and Teams. Missing for 10: any evidence that the assistant explains card declines, explicit pre-spend policy checks outside travel and spend requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the conversational policy enforcement.
